lenses.name: Population
lenses.description: Residents per km² of department land.

lenses.name: GDP per capita
lenses.description: Department GDP divided by residents. Unlike the original US map, this is not household income.

lenses.name: Employment density
lenses.description: Employment by workplace per km² of department land.

lenses.name: Industry
lenses.description: Industry and construction employment as a share of all employment.

lenses.name: Forest
lenses.description: Share of each hex classified as tree cover by CORINE Land Cover.

lenses.name: Farmland
lenses.description: Share of each hex classified as cropland by CORINE Land Cover.

lenses.name: Built-up
lenses.description: Share of each hex classified as built-up by CORINE Land Cover.

lenses.name: Median standard of living
lenses.description: Median standard of living by department (INSEE comparateur de territoires 2023).

lenses.name: Poverty
lenses.description: Share of residents below 60% of median standard of living.

lenses.name: Second homes
lenses.description: Second homes and occasional dwellings as a share of all dwellings.

lenses.name: Vacant homes
lenses.description: Vacant dwellings as a share of all dwellings.
